framework.section1Philosophy: Veervrat is a structured practice of self-reliance. It begins with honest self-examination — not to judge, but to understand. When we know what holds us back, we can work on it deliberately.
framework.section1StanceBody: We believe in your autonomy. No advice, no prescriptions. Veervrat gives you the structure; what you do with it is entirely your own.
framework.section1VmBody: A vratmitra accompanies you on the practice. They reflect, question, and encourage — but they do not direct. The practice is yours.
framework.stage1Body: Name what holds you back. Take the test, see the sentences, understand the pattern.
framework.stage2Body: Explore each weakness through sentences and their linked virtues. Understand the root.
framework.stage3Body: Choose an exposure, resolution, or challenge. Work on it daily. Log check-ins.
framework.stage4Body: Complete the journey. Reflect. The weakness becomes a starting point, not an endpoint.
framework.ctaTitle: Ready to take your first test?
framework.ctaBody: The test shows you which sentences resonate — and which virtues they point toward.
